t: This bronze figure is the statue of Sherlock Holmes, standing outside Baker Street tube station on Marylebone Road. It was unveiled on 23 September 1999 near the supposed site of 221B Baker Street, and the Abbey National building society, whose headquarters stood on that purported site, paid for it. John Doubleday sculpted it. He had already made a Holmes for Meiringen in Switzerland, below the Reichenbach Falls. His other subjects include Nelson Mandela, Golda Meir, The Beatles, and Laurel and Hardy.
